args.sql:
ALTER TABLE transactions
ADD COLUMN risk VARCHAR(10);

UPDATE transactions AS t
SET risk =
    CASE
        WHEN r.fraudprob > 0.5 OR r.moneyrisk = 'High' THEN 'High'
        WHEN r.fraudprob BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 OR r.moneyrisk = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN r.fraudprob < 0.3 AND r.moneyrisk = 'Low' THEN 'Low'
    END
FROM riskanalysis AS r
WHERE t.txregistry = r.txref;
